Ryshcate Sweet Breads

Served at: Life Day (Wookiee Tradition)

Makes 12-15 small breadsPrep 30 minCook 25 min

Ryshcate Sweet Breads are a beloved staple of Life Day celebrations across Kashyyyk and beyond, symbolizing warmth, family, and the interconnectedness of all life. These slightly sweet, spiced breads are traditionally shared among family and friends, often braided or shaped into small, individual portions, making them perfect for communal feasting during the annual Wookiee holiday.

Ingredients

  • 1 cup (240ml) warm nut milk (or whole milk), about 105-115°F (40-46°C)
  • 2 1/4 teaspoons (7g) active dry yeast
  • 1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar, plus a pinch
  • 1 large egg, at room temperature
  • 1/4 cup (56g) unsalted butter, melted and cooled, plus more for greasing
  • 1 teaspoon (5g) salt
  • 1 teaspoon ground forest spice blend (cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger)
  • 3 1/2 to 4 cups (420-480g) all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
  • 1/2 cup (75g) chopped dried rishii berries (or cranberries/raisins)
  • For the Glaze:
  • 1 cup (120g) powdered sugar
  • 2-3 tablespoons (30-45ml) nut milk (or regular milk)
  • 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Method

  1. In a large bowl, combine the warm nut milk, yeast, and a pinch of granulated sugar. Stir gently and let sit for 5-10 minutes until foamy.
  2. Whisk in the remaining 1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar, egg, melted butter, salt, and forest spice blend into the yeast mixture.
  3. Gradually add 3 1/2 cups (420g) of the flour, mixing with a wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface.
  4. Knead the dough for 8-10 minutes, adding more flour a tablespoon at a time if the dough is too sticky, until it is smooth and elastic. Incorporate the chopped dried rishii berries during the last minute of kneading.
  5. Lightly grease a clean bowl with butter. Place the dough in the bowl, turning once to coat. Cover with plastic wrap or a clean kitchen towel and let rise in a warm place for 1 to 1.5 hours, or until doubled in size.
  6. Gently punch down the risen dough. Divide it into 12-15 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a round bun, or roll into a rope and braid, or form into small knots.
  7. Place the shaped breads on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving some space between them. Cover loosely with plastic wrap or a towel and let rise again for 30-45 minutes, or until visibly puffy.
  8. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).
  9. Bake the Ryshcate Sweet Breads for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown on top and cooked through. If they brown too quickly, you can loosely tent them with foil.
  10. While the breads are cooling slightly, prepare the glaze: whisk together the powdered sugar, nut milk, and vanilla extract in a small bowl until smooth.
  11. Once the breads are warm but not hot, drizzle or brush the glaze over them. Serve warm and enjoy the spirit of Life Day.

Tips

  • For an extra festive touch, sprinkle a pinch of edible glitter or finely chopped nuts over the glaze before it sets.
  • If you prefer a richer flavor, you can brush the tops of the breads with an egg wash (1 egg beaten with 1 tablespoon water) before baking for a shinier, golden crust.
  • Ryshcate Sweet Breads are best enjoyed fresh, but leftovers can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days, or frozen for longer storage.
